name: ETH+BTC spot-confirmed favourite, maker entry
description: sol-zfav-maker's rule unchanged on ETH and BTC: post-only one tick inside the spread on the favourite's side when spot is >=1.5 sigma (15-min realized vol) past the strike, 420..150 s to close, repriced every 30 s, held to settlement.
hypothesis: The zfav maker rule earns +1.2c (SOL), +1.4c (XRP), +2.1c (DOGE), stronger on thinner markets. Rule and parameters fixed in advance, no tuning. Wrong if full CI <=0, <60% months positive or 2x latency negative.
